title: The Miraculousness And Testimony Of The Quran 17th Degree The Impossibility Of Producing Its Like In View Of Source Addressee And Purpose

questions.question: According to the passage, what three things help show the worth and excellence of any speech?
questions.answer: Its source, its audience, and its purpose.

questions.question: Why does the passage say nothing can match the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because it comes from the Lord of all creation, addresses the greatest messenger on behalf of all beings, and deals with the deepest truths about life, the universe, and the next world.

questions.question: How is the speaker of the Qur’an described?
questions.answer: As the Sustainer of all worlds and the Creator of the entire universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the style of this divine address?
questions.answer: It says it is free from imitation and artificial performance.

questions.question: Who is described as the direct recipient of the Qur’anic address?
questions.answer: The Messenger sent in the name of all human beings, and even all creatures.

questions.question: What makes that recipient especially significant in the passage?
questions.answer: He is presented as the most honored and well-known of people, with a faith so vast and powerful that it gave rise to Islam and brought him to a very high nearness to Allah.

questions.question: What major subjects does the Qur’an explain, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It explains what leads to success in this life and the next, the outcomes of creation, and the divine purposes within the universe.

questions.question: How does the passage present the belief of the Messenger?
questions.answer: As the highest and widest form of belief, carrying all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: What comparison is used for the Qur’an’s presentation of the universe?
questions.answer: It is said to display the universe like something clearly laid out and understandable, such as a map, a clock, or a house.

questions.question: In what manner does the Qur’an teach about the universe?
questions.answer: It teaches it in the way the Maker of the universe would explain His own work.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from the Qur’an’s source, audience, and subject matter?
questions.answer: That producing anything equal to it is impossible and its miraculous rank cannot be reached.

questions.question: What does the passage say many highly intelligent scholars have done?
questions.answer: They have written detailed commentaries explaining and proving the Qur’an’s many qualities, subtleties, secrets, meanings, and signs.

questions.question: How extensive are some of those commentaries said to be?
questions.answer: Some are said to run to dozens of volumes, even up to seventy.

questions.question: What kinds of things do those scholarly works try to show in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Its countless features, refined points, deep meanings, hidden indications, and references to unseen matters.

questions.question: What special role is given to the Risale-i Nur in the passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as a body of writings in which each part demonstrates a distinct quality, subtle point, or truth of the Qur’an with strong proofs.

questions.question: What is the overall effect of all these scholarly explanations and proofs?
questions.answer: They serve as a confirming sign that the Qur’an has no equal, is miraculous, and speaks from the unseen world into the visible world.

questions.question: What basic principle about speech is stated at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The greatness of speech becomes clear when we know who spoke it, who receives it, and why it was spoken.

questions.question: Based on that principle, why is the Qur’an presented as beyond comparison?
questions.answer: Because its speaker is Allah, its first addressee is the greatest messenger, and its purpose covers the most important realities of existence.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the relationship between the Qur’an and imitation?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an shows no sign of being copied or artificially produced.

questions.question: To whom is the Qur’an addressed beyond ordinary individuals?
questions.answer: It is addressed through the Prophet to all people and, in a broader sense, all beings.

questions.question: What effect of the Prophet’s faith is highlighted?
questions.answer: Its power and breadth gave birth to the great civilization and religion of Islam.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention the Prophet’s high spiritual station?
questions.answer: To show the nobility of the one receiving the Qur’an and thereby the greatness of the speech addressed to him.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an teach about human life?
questions.answer: It teaches what leads to well-being in both this world and the next.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about the universe itself?
questions.answer: It explains why the universe was created and what divine purposes are at work within it.

questions.question: How is the Prophet’s belief connected to the Qur’an’s message?
questions.answer: His belief is described as embracing all the truths that the Qur’an sets forth.

questions.question: What do the images of a map, a clock, and a house suggest about the Qur’an’s teaching?
questions.answer: They suggest that the Qur’an makes the universe understandable, ordered, and purposeful.

questions.question: Why is it significant that the Qur’an explains the universe as its Maker would?
questions.answer: Because that implies complete knowledge and authority, which human speech cannot match.

questions.question: What does the passage say thousands of scholars have contributed?
questions.answer: Careful, learned commentaries that examine the Qur’an in detail and support its extraordinary nature with evidence.

questions.question: What areas of the Qur’an do these scholars explore?
questions.answer: Its qualities, subtleties, distinguishing features, hidden meanings, elevated themes, and signs about realities beyond ordinary sight.

questions.question: How is the Risale-i Nur described in relation to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: As a set of works whose separate sections each uncover and prove a particular light or truth from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the mention of topics like technology and unseen indications suggest about the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: It suggests that the Qur’an contains layered meanings that later scholars can continue to discover and explain.

questions.question: What final claim is supported by the combined witness of these scholars and works?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an is unmatched, miraculous, and a divine speech bringing knowledge of the unseen into the visible world.

questions.question: What three questions should be asked to judge the quality of a statement, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Who said it, who it is directed to, and what purpose it serves.

questions.question: What answer does the passage give to the question of who speaks the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The Lord of all realms and the Creator of everything.

questions.question: What answer does the passage give to the question of who receives the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The Messenger sent on behalf of humanity and all creation.

questions.question: What answer does the passage give to the question of the Qur’an’s purpose?
questions.answer: To explain the path to success in both worlds, the outcomes of creation, and the divine wisdom in the universe.

questions.question: How does the passage characterize the Qur’an as speech?
questions.answer: As a true divine address, not something staged, borrowed, or forced.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s fame and honor mentioned in this argument?
questions.answer: Because the greatness of the one addressed helps show the greatness of the message given to him.

questions.question: What role does the Prophet’s strong faith play in the passage’s reasoning?
questions.answer: It shows that the recipient of the Qur’an had an extraordinary spiritual capacity fitting such a revelation.

questions.question: What is implied by saying his faith carried all the truths of Islam?
questions.answer: That his belief was complete, comprehensive, and fully aligned with the Qur’an’s teachings.

questions.question: How does the Qur’an deal with the universe in the passage?
questions.answer: It turns toward the whole universe, displays it from every angle, and explains it clearly.

questions.question: What do the examples used for the universe indicate about the Qur’an’s method?
questions.answer: They indicate that it presents creation as structured, meaningful, and understandable.

questions.question: Why does the passage conclude that no one can produce something equal to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because no human can speak with the authority, scope, and perfect knowledge described there.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number and ability of scholars who studied the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says many thousands of highly intelligent and precise scholars studied it deeply.

questions.question: What is the purpose of mentioning commentaries of many volumes?
questions.answer: To show the depth of the Qur’an and the vast effort scholars have made to explain its meanings.

questions.question: What kinds of realities do those commentaries discuss?
questions.answer: They discuss fine distinctions, deep secrets, elevated meanings, and signs related to hidden and unseen matters.

questions.question: How is each part of the Risale-i Nur presented?
questions.answer: As a work that proves a specific dimension of the Qur’an’s truth and wonder.

questions.question: What two major conclusions are drawn at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an has no equal and that it is a miraculous divine message connected to the unseen.

questions.question: What standard for evaluating speech is given in the opening sentence?
questions.answer: A speech is judged by its speaker, its intended listener, and its aim.

questions.question: How does that standard support the claim that the Qur’an is unique?
questions.answer: It shows that its speaker, audience, and mission are all at the highest possible level.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the source of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: That it comes from the Lord and Creator of all existence.

questions.question: What feature of the Qur’an’s delivery separates it from ordinary human speech?
questions.answer: It lacks any trace of copied style or made-up display.

questions.question: How broad is the mission of the one who receives the Qur’an in the passage?
questions.answer: His mission extends to all people and, in a wider sense, all beings.

questions.question: What historical and spiritual impact of the Prophet’s faith is mentioned?
questions.answer: It generated mighty Islam and raised him to an exalted nearness to Allah.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about worldly and eternal life?
questions.answer: It explains the matters that lead to happiness and success in both.

questions.question: What does the passage say about creation and the universe?
questions.answer: The Qur’an explains the results of creation and the divine purposes working within the universe.

questions.question: How is the Prophet’s belief described in relation to Islamic truth?
questions.answer: As the loftiest and most inclusive belief, containing all Islamic truths.

questions.question: What is the significance of saying the Qur’an shows every side of the universe?
questions.answer: It means the Qur’an gives a wide, balanced, and insightful understanding of existence.

questions.question: Why is the image of the Craftsman important?
questions.answer: It suggests that the one explaining the universe knows it completely because He made it.

questions.question: What evidence from scholarship is introduced after the discussion of the Qur’an’s content?
questions.answer: The work of many exact and learned scholars who wrote detailed commentaries proving its many dimensions.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention large numbers of volumes in these commentaries?
questions.answer: To emphasize the richness and depth of the Qur’an’s meanings.

questions.question: What subjects are said to be found in the Qur’an according to these scholars?
questions.answer: Numerous qualities, mysteries, subtle meanings, and indications related even to hidden realities.

questions.question: How does the passage use the Risale-i Nur as evidence?
questions.answer: It presents its many sections as examples of works that each uncover and demonstrate a particular Qur’anic truth.

questions.question: What final understanding should the reader take from this passage about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: That it is incomparable, miraculous, and a true divine word revealing unseen knowledge in the visible world.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes the rank of words or speech clear?
questions.answer: Knowing their origin, their audience, and their purpose.

questions.question: Why is this idea important for understanding the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because once those three matters are considered, the Qur’an’s superiority becomes evident.

questions.question: What is the Qur’an said to be in relation to Allah?
questions.answer: A divine address from the Lord of all worlds and the Creator of the universe.

questions.question: How does the passage rule out the idea that the Qur’an is merely human expression?
questions.answer: It describes it as free from signs of imitation or artificial construction.

questions.question: In whose name is the Prophet said to receive the Qur’an?
questions.answer: In the name of all humanity, and even all beings.

questions.question: What qualities of the Prophet are emphasized here?
questions.answer: His unmatched renown, his immense faith, and his lofty spiritual station.

questions.question: What did that immense faith lead to in the world?
questions.answer: It gave rise to the powerful reality of Islam.

questions.question: What kinds of guidance does the Qur’an provide?
questions.answer: Guidance about life now, life after death, the meaning of creation, and the divine aims within the universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the scope of the Prophet’s belief?
questions.answer: It was broad enough to carry all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: How does the Qur’an help people understand the universe?
questions.answer: It lays out the universe clearly and explains it as the One who made it would explain it.

questions.question: What inference does the passage expect the reader to make from that?
questions.answer: That no human being can produce another book with the same level of knowledge and authority.

questions.question: What kind of scholarly response has the Qur’an received?
questions.answer: It has received careful and extensive study from many highly intelligent scholars.

questions.question: What do these scholars attempt to prove?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an contains countless subtle features, deep meanings, and signs pointing to hidden matters.

questions.question: How is the depth of Qur’anic study illustrated in the passage?
questions.answer: By mentioning commentaries that span many volumes.

questions.question: What function do the parts of the Risale-i Nur serve in this argument?
questions.answer: They act as examples showing that each section can uncover a specific aspect of the Qur’an’s miraculous nature.

questions.question: What overall testimony do all these scholarly works give?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an is without equal, miraculous, and a true word from the Knower of the unseen.

questions.question: What does the passage say must be known in order to recognize the excellence of speech?
questions.answer: The one who speaks, the one addressed, and the reason for the speech.

questions.question: How does the passage apply that principle to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It presents all three elements at the highest level, which proves the Qur’an cannot be rivaled.

questions.question: Who is identified as the speaker of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The Lord of all realms and Maker of the entire universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say about any suggestion of literary pretense in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says there is no hint of copied style or affected speech in it.

questions.question: Who is the addressee of the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: The Messenger who represents all people, and even all beings.

questions.question: Why is the addressee’s status part of the argument for the Qur’an’s greatness?
questions.answer: Because a message sent to the noblest and most spiritually elevated messenger carries special weight and dignity.

questions.question: What outcomes of the Qur’an are connected to human well-being?
questions.answer: It teaches what brings happiness and success in both worldly life and the hereafter.

questions.question: What explanation does the Qur’an give regarding the universe?
questions.answer: It explains the consequences of creation and the divine purposes present within it.

questions.question: How is the Messenger’s faith described?
questions.answer: As supremely high, vast in scope, and inclusive of all Islamic truths.

questions.question: What do the examples of a map, a clock, and a house help the reader understand?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an presents the universe as ordered, intelligible, and full of purpose.

questions.question: Why is it significant that the universe is taught in the manner of its Maker?
questions.answer: Because that points to complete mastery and knowledge beyond human capability.

questions.question: What conclusion follows from this description of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: That no one can produce its equal and its miraculous level cannot be reached.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number and caliber of Qur’anic commentators?
questions.answer: They are many thousands of highly intelligent, careful, and learned scholars.

questions.question: What have these commentators shown through evidence and reasoning?
questions.answer: They have shown countless qualities, refined meanings, secrets, and indications within the Qur’an, including matters related to the unseen.

questions.question: How is the Risale-i Nur used to strengthen the argument?
questions.answer: It is presented as a collection in which each part proves a distinct light or truth of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What final description of the Qur’an sums up the passage’s message?
questions.answer: It is an unmatched miracle and a divine word bringing truths of the unseen into the visible world.
